_comment: Paperclip DIRECT adapter config: routes an agent straight through the llm-provider OpenAI-compatible endpoint (grok + local models + claude), NO hermes. execute(ctx) POSTs to /v1/chat/completions and streams via ctx.onLog. Remote access uses SHORT-LIVED tokens: credsFile points at a JSON bundle { access_token, refresh_token, expires_at } minted by the gateway; the adapter auto-rotates it via POST /auth/refresh near expiry (no permanent key). On a REMOTE Paperclip (VPS), set baseUrl to the reverse-tunnel endpoint (e.g. http://172.16.0.1:4141/v1) and credsFile to a bundle copied onto that host. For loopback on this Mac, no key is needed; apiKey/apiKeyFile remain supported for static keys.
